sources.read_scope: Theorem 2B.3, printed page 172, and local orientations on printed pages 233-235.
sources.use: A continuous local injection between equal-dimensional manifolds is a local homeomorphism. Comparison of pulled-back and chosen orientations is locally constant. The application to our connected K is derived in the report.
